text.p: Tropical Cyclone 17P is a weak system with top winds near 30 mph. It is in the Samoa Islands at this time, moving slowly to the west. It will continue this track, weakening, and dissipating during the next 24 hours, though heavy showers and squalls accompanying the tropical system may cause local flash flooding.

Tropical Cyclone 18S, centered in the southern Indian Ocean near 24s/88e, is moving south southwest at 16 mph. Top winds are 50 mph and will drop off this period as the storm weakens, dissipating in 36 hours. During this time it will still be a moderate threat to shipping but no threat to land.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
